root_motivation: The wintermute kernel stamps structured provenance xattrs on every file (user.prov.session, user.prov.ts), but no userspace tool decodes the structure — the only consumer (provenance-mcp) throws it away as an opaque string. Without a canonical parser, the skill attribution, agent identity, and environment that wrote every file are permanently invisible to the system. This crate is the single decoder that makes provenance first-class and prevents breakage when the agentns-id form activates.
user_persona: Joe Yen running wintermute automation tools — Rust CLIs installed to ~/.local/bin/ on Arch Linux with the booted 7.0.11-arch1-1-wintermute kernel (provfs live). Also consumed programmatically by future colophon-attribute, colophon-stale, and colophon-digest crates.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does this PRD build a provenance parser?
five_whys_trace.a: The booted wintermute kernel stamps user.prov.session xattrs but the only consumer (provenance-mcp) discards the structure, returning an opaque string.

five_whys_trace.q: Why is discarding the structure a problem?
five_whys_trace.a: The comm-chain encodes which Claude skill wrote the file (dream, build, self-review) and the environment it ran in — skill attribution is permanently lost without a parser.
The entire colophon fleet (attribute, stale, digest) depends on knowing what wrote what — without the decoder, none of those future tools can be built.

five_whys_trace.q: Why not patch provenance-mcp instead of a new crate?
five_whys_trace.a: provenance-mcp has a different concern (MCP protocol bridge); a separate canonical decoder lets any tool depend on it without pulling in MCP protocol machinery. Also must handle both comm-chain and agentns-id forms from day one.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should the crate be cli or lib? It needs both a library API and a binary.
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: target_kind=cli with a pub lib module in src/lib.rs (standard Rust pattern). The binary in src/main.rs is thin.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does AC6's real-file integration test block the gate on machines without provfs?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: No — skip with eprintln! when getfattr returns no user.prov.session. The --from-string path is always exercised.
